description: Expander for Chord-Key, placed immediately to the right of it: four quantizers that snap incoming pitches to the notes of the chord selected in Chord-Key. On its own it quantizes chromatically

params.text: Transposes that channel by whole octaves, -4 to +4, before it is quantized

inputs.text: Pitch to be quantized on that channel; a polyphonic cable is quantized channel by channel

outputs.text: The quantized pitch for that channel

notes: the connection is made by position: the panels must touch, with no gap between them
